title: FormLayout
description: A native form whose fields are laid out on a responsive grid; submit, reset and validation keep their native behaviour.

props.name: columns
props.description:
Column counts of the inner ResponsiveGrid: a number, or `{ base, sm, md, lg }`
(container widths 480 / 768 / 1200px). Integers 1-12

props.name: gap
props.description:
Gap between fields: numbers and numeric strings select spacing tokens,
other strings are CSS values

vars.name: --form-layout-max-width
vars.description: Maximum width of the form (none by default)

vars.name: --form-layout-margin-inline
vars.description: Inline margin of the form (set auto with a max width to center it)

files.README.md:
# vue-form

Standalone Vue 3 recipe, using only public Minerva entries.

Requires Node >=22.13 and pnpm 11. Copy the complete directory, then run:

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm build
pnpm dev
```

The package manifest pins the tested Minerva/framework/tool versions. The entry imports the global stylesheet once. App owns the provider and controlled state. No documentation translation setup or workspace aliases are required.
files.src/App.vue:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from "vue";
import {
  Button,
  ConfigProvider,
  FormField,
  Input,
  Switch,
  VStack,
} from "minerva-design/vue";
const name = ref("");
const subscribed = ref(false);
const saved = ref("");
</script>
<template>
  <ConfigProvider theme="light"
    ><VStack :gap="4" align="start">
      <FormField label="Project name" required
        ><Input name="project" v-model="name" clearable
      /></FormField>
      <Switch label="Newsletter" v-model="subscribed" />
      <Button
        :disabled="!name.trim()"
        @click="saved = `${name}${subscribed ? ' · subscribed' : ''}`"
        >Save project</Button
      >
      <output aria-live="polite">{{ saved || "No project saved" }}</output>
    </VStack></ConfigProvider
  >
</template>

FormLayoutProps.columns: Column counts of the inner ResponsiveGrid: a number, or `{ base, sm, md, lg }` (container widths 480 / 768 / 1200px). Integers 1-12
FormLayoutProps.gap: Gap between fields: numbers and numeric strings select spacing tokens, other strings are CSS values

cssVars.--form-layout-max-width: Maximum width of the form (none by default)
cssVars.--form-layout-margin-inline: Inline margin of the form (set auto with a max width to center it)

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: Place the layout inside a native <form>: submit, reset and validation stay native. columns="1 2" gives one column on narrow containers and two from 480px; minerva-grid-item full-width spans a row.

gaps.title: Columns and gaps
gaps.description: gap sets both gaps; row-gap and column-gap override them (spacing token numbers or CSS lengths). Works with native fields too.

cssVars.--responsive-grid-align-items: Vertical alignment of the fields in their row (default: stretch).
cssVars.--responsive-grid-justify-items: Horizontal alignment of the fields in their column (default: stretch).
